const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "function strip(s){ return String(s||'').replace(/<!\\[CDATA\\[/g,'').replace(/\\]\\]>/g,'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim(); }",
 "(async function(){",
 " // Upwork 有官方 RSS（job feed），试试",
 " const cands=[",
 " ['upwork_rss_generic','https://www.upwork.com/ab/feed/jobs/rss?q=automation&sort=recency'],",
 " ['upwork_rss_alt','https://www.upwork.com/ab/feed/topics/rss?securityToken=&userUid=&orgUid=&q=automation'],",
 " ['freelancer_rss','https://www.freelancer.com/rss.xml'],",
 " ['remoteok_rss','https://remoteok.com/remote-dev-jobs.rss'],",
 " ['weworkremotely_rss','https://weworkremotely.com/categories/remote-programming-jobs.rss']",
 " ];",
 " for(const t of cands){",
 " try{",
 " const r=await get(t[1]);",
 " const isXml=r.body.indexOf('<?xml')===0 || r.body.indexOf('<rss')===0 || r.body.indexOf('<feed')>=0;",
 " console.log('=== '+t[0]+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length+' xml='+isXml);",
 " if(isXml){",
 " const n=(r.body.match(/<item>/g)||[]).length + (r.body.match(/<entry>/g)||[]).length;",
 " console.log(' entries: '+n);",
 " const first=/<title[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(r.body);",
 " console.log(' first title: '+strip(first?first[1]:''));",
 " }",
 " }catch(e){ console.log(t[0]+' ERR '+e.message); }",
 " await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,4000)});",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-fr.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-fr.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Probe freelance job RSS feeds", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 5000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
  "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "function strip(s){ return String(s||'').replace(/<!\\[CDATA\\[/g,'').replace(/\\]\\]>/g,'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim(); }",
  "(async function(){",
  "  // Upwork 有官方 RSS（job feed），试试",
  "  const cands=[",
  "    ['upwork_rss_generic','https://www.upwork.com/ab/feed/jobs/rss?q=automation&sort=recency'],",
  "    ['upwork_rss_alt','https://www.upwork.com/ab/feed/topics/rss?securityToken=&userUid=&orgUid=&q=automation'],",
  "    ['freelancer_rss','https://www.freelancer.com/rss.xml'],",

  "      const r=await get(t[1]);",

  "      if(isXml){",
  "        const n=(r.body.match(/<item>/g)||[]).length + (r.body.match(/<entry>/g)||[]).length;",
  "        console.log('    entries: '+n);",
  "        const first=/<title[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(r.body);",
  "        console.log('    first title: '+strip(first?first[1]:''));",
  "      }",
  "    }catch(e){ console.log(t[0]+' ERR '+e.message); }",
  "    await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,4000)});",
  "  }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-fr.cjs", content: js });
